title: CloudEventEnvelope
description: CloudEvents v1.0 compliant envelope specification for Google Cloud Pub/Sub message payloads

specversion.description: The version of the CloudEvents specification which the event uses.

id.description: Identifies the event uniquely. Must be a valid UUIDv4 string.

source.description: Identifies the context in which an event happened (e.g. URI reference /urn:uuid:... or https://service.domain/context).

type.description: Describes the type of event related to the originating occurrence (reverse-DNS string e.g. com.system.task.created.v1).

subject.description: Describes the subject of the event in the context of the event producer (e.g. task UUID or entity path).

time.description: Timestamp of when the occurrence happened adhering to RFC 3339 / ISO 8601.

datacontenttype.description: Content type of the data value. Must be application/json.

dataschema.description: Identifies the schema that data adheres to.

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header enabling distributed end-to-end tracing across async message boundaries.

tracestate.description: W3C Trace Context tracestate header providing vendor-specific tracing routing information.

data.description: The event payload data conforming to the schema associated with the event type.
